prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: KeLing existing product logo symbol, transparent application icon. Edit the supplied title_logo.png ONLY by extracting the LEFT-HAND PIXEL ART PLANET SYMBOL from the existing logo. Preserve that exact existing identity: navy/teal/mint globe with cream open book on its surface, cream and mint Saturn ring diagonally rising to the right, small existing gold/coral stars around it. Remove every Chinese word, all KELING English lettering, and every ornament belonging to the lettering on the right. Do not redesign the planet, do not invent a mascot, face, new objects, rounded tile, gradient background or new letters. Keep the same pixel shapes, color palette, proportions, thick navy outline, and existing texture as closely as possible. Complete the far-right orbital ring edge cleanly where the text previously touched it. Center the isolated planet-and-ring mark in a square transparent canvas, occupy about 84% of width with 8% safe transparent padding each side, leaving enough vertical padding for its original wide proportions. Real alpha transparent outside the mark, no opaque background and no checkerboard. No text, no watermark. This must look like the actual planet portion of the supplied logo, not a new interpretation.

Edit this supplied extracted KeLing planet symbol for APPLICATION ICON delivery. Mandatory output aspect ratio 1:1, a square PNG canvas (1024 by 1024 or another exactly square resolution). The only permitted change is canvas/framing and removal of the surrounding dark translucent glow. Keep the existing planet, open book, rings, satellite dots and star pixel geometry and palette unchanged. Fit the full existing wide symbol inside the square canvas with the widest ring endpoints spanning about 84% of square width. Add transparent empty space ABOVE and BELOW to achieve the square; do not stretch the symbol to fill height. Background must be fully alpha-transparent, alpha zero away from solid outlined symbol; no dark square, no glow, no shadow, no checkerboard. Retain the solid navy stroke on the symbol itself. No letters, no words, no rounded container. A single centered square app icon, not a banner.
intent: Use the existing title logo's book-and-ring planet symbol for browser and application identity; remove wordmark.
